scope: Only the reviewed accepted score inventory in these three existing primary conditions. New or hidden records require a refreshed review. No automatic classification of future submissions.

standard.name: Official direct evaluation · Semi-private
standard.explanation: ARC Prize direct input-to-output evaluation on the official ARC-AGI-1 semi-private set. Includes verified direct model API runs; excludes external solver scaffolds, custom competition systems and explicitly enabled code execution. Provider-internal reasoning remains part of the evaluated model. Effort and resource budgets remain per-run metadata. Publisher citations without verified harness evidence are separate. Source: https://arcprize.org/policy

custom.name: Custom systems / tools · Semi-private
custom.explanation: ARC-AGI-1 semi-private scores using external solver scaffolds, custom competition systems or explicitly enabled code execution. Official verification of a score does not imply the official direct model configuration. The exact solver and run settings remain attached to each score; this collection does not assert a shared harness.

unverified.name: Harness unverified · Semi-private
unverified.explanation: Published ARC-AGI-1 semi-private scores whose use of the official direct evaluation configuration has not been verified in the current evidence. An absent Harness field, a matching score or a quotation by a model vendor is insufficient. These scores are retained, but are not included in the default official direct condition.

provider-adapter.name: Provider Adapter · Semi-private
provider-adapter.explanation: Official ARC Prize Provider Adapter evaluation on the ARC-AGI-3 semi-private set. Provider-designed context management may preserve reasoning state and compact conversations. This is an official condition, separate from the default Standard harness; the two do not measure the same operating setup. Source: https://arcprize.org/blog/astra#two-harnesses-two-questions
